name: Rowan Montalvo
role: Electronic and physical observation expert — surveillance specialist
location: Ashfield — former residential district, half-burned, now squatter territory, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Rowan Montalvo is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 40, the augmentation scarring around his temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Rowan Montalvo plans to keep it that way. He works as a surveillance specialist out of Ashfield, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Rowan Montalvo describe him as a precision instrument — point him at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
coping_mechanisms: Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
psychology.secret: Alper Holmberg-Dembele is addicted to combat stims. Functions fine on them, can't function without them. The dependency is invisible to everyone except their street doc.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
example_lines: "I've been watching you for three days. You should close your curtains."
"Information is the only commodity that appreciates with age."
"Everyone thinks they're careful. Nobody is careful enough."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Alper Holmberg-Dembele's reputation — and a price for silence
Alper Holmberg-Dembele discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
Alper Holmberg-Dembele intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: As a surveillance specialist, Alper Holmberg-Dembele embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm. Cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic, obvious chrome
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots
augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

cyberware_inventory.name: Subdermal weapon mount
cyberware_inventory.description: Subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm

cyberware_inventory.name: Cybernetic arm
cyberware_inventory.description: Cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic, obvious chrome

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Confession' Modified Industrial Nail Gun

physical_description.heritage: Pacific Islander (40%), Hispanic/Latin American (39%), and Indigenous American (21%) — a diaspora blend creating warm medium-deep skin with golden and olive undertones. The broader facial structure, defined cheekbones, and prominent squared jaw reflect Pacific Islander and Indigenous American ancestry. Higher, more angular cheekbones and slightly wider face structure are characteristic of indigenous Pacific and American lineages, while the warmth and depth of complexion draws from all three heritage groups' tropical and equatorial origins.
physical_description.build: Stocky and solid, thick through the chest and shoulders with the compact density of someone who has spent decades maintaining functional strength rather than aesthetic muscle. Forearms are visibly corded, scarred from repeated augmentation work.
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-deep warm tan with golden and olive undertones, weathered from years in Ashfield's polluted air and inconsistent shelter. The warmth and depth reflect the blended ancestry across Pacific Islander, Hispanic/Latin American, and Indigenous American heritage.
physical_description.complexion: Hard-lined face with broader, fuller bone structure reflecting Pacific Islander and Indigenous American ancestry. Jaw is prominent and squared. Cheekbones are higher and more defined, with slightly wider face structure characteristic of Pacific Islander and Indigenous American lineages. Deep nasolabial folds frame the mouth. Skin texture rough, pockmarked around the temple and jawline where augmentation scarring pulls slightly at the surface. Five-o'clock shadow is his default state. Eyes sit deep-set, giving him a permanently tired appearance that suits his work.
distinguishing_marks: Augmentation scarring in a horseshoe pattern around both temples, pale pink tissue against warm tan skin, from subdermal blade mount installation.
Jagged scar running from left jaw angle down toward the clavicle, approximately 8cm, old and white — pre-augmentation injury.
Heavy keloid scarring across both inner forearms where the weapon mounts were installed, visible when his sleeves are rolled.
Burn mark on right shoulder — crescent-shaped, roughly 5cm across, from industrial accident or weapons discharge, old enough to have faded to light brown.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right arm is full-replacement cybernetic from shoulder joint down — obvious chrome and polished steel, synthetic muscle layering visible at the elbow joint. The arm is noticeably stronger and more refined than organic tissue, with articulation that's too precise. Pop-out blade mounts are visible along both forearms as chrome-lined slots, sealed but obvious to anyone who knows what they're looking at. Subdermal scarring around temples indicates weapon mount installation beneath the skin.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight balanced forward on the balls of his feet, a runner's ready stance. Moves deliberately, economically — no wasted motion. His right arm compensates with slight mechanical hesitation on fast movements, but he's so practiced with it that the hesitation reads as control rather than disability. Hands rest in fists more often than open palms. His gaze is active, tracking, never settling — the paranoia is embedded in his body language.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 utilitarian — worn synthweave cargo pants with visible equipment loops, reinforced at stress points. Sleeveless or short-sleeved tops to keep the right arm visible and unobstructed, usually unmarked dark gray or black. Over this, a faded ballistic jacket with multiple pockets, patched at the elbows, missing the logo from its original brand. Steel-toed boots, scuffed, re-soled multiple times. No jewelry, no identifying markers beyond his augmentations. Clothing is functional and replaceable, not an investment.

image_prompt: Rowan Montalvo, 2226 neo-noir operative, 178cm stocky solid frame. Warm medium-deep golden-olive tan skin, weathered Pacific Islander and Indigenous American features with prominent squared jaw and defined high cheekbones. Dark brown hair graying at temples, cropped short. Pale gray baseline eyes, deep-set and tired. Five-o'clock shadow. Pale pink horseshoe augmentation scarring at temples, old white jaw scar, heavy keloid forearm scarring visible. Full-replacement right arm cybernetic chrome and steel with visible synthetic muscle at elbow, pop-out blade mount slots along forearms. Sleeveless dark gray shirt, worn synthweave cargo pants with equipment loops, faded ballistic jacket patched at elbows, scuffed steel-toed boots. Stands in ready stance, weight forward on balls of feet. Hands in fists. Active, tracking gaze.
